description: This file defines the HomeController class for managing the state and data flow of the home feature in a Flutter app. It handles loading the home feed, continue watching list, and background cache refresh logic.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: Manages the state and data fetching for the home screen, including loading status, payload, error messages, and continuing watching list. Implements cache refresh and listener management.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the home feed data, updates state, and initiates the continue watching load if auto-start is enabled.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches recent watch history and corresponding content details for the continue watching feature.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes continue watching data after playback progress is saved.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the home feed and continue watching data to reflect cached updates.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the cache listener and marks the controller as disposed.
